experiment_template.research_question: Can the generic recovery gate close while the decisive revised fact is absent from selected context?
stop_conditions: No provider calls or serving changes.
Retain every observed outcome; changed construction requires a new binding.
Stop on receipt mismatch or fixture mutation.

success_criteria.counterevidence: All pressured rows have full exposure and either retain decisive revision or offer further recovery.
success_criteria.inconclusive: Pressure fails to establish confirmed pre-recycle revision delivery or controls fail.
success_criteria.supporting: At least one fully exposed pressured row passes generic gate with decisive revision absent and submission as sole tool; all unpressured controls correctly resolve their value.

experiment_template.treatment_ref: same candidate with synthetic pressure after six confirmed model requests

falsifier: Under confirmed delivery followed by recycling, decisive facts remain available or recovery tools remain offered in all controlled cases.
mechanism: The gate measures any meaningful archived page; nativeReady then restricts the tool set to submission without checking task-specific fact availability.
scope: Local scripted structural test of the unchanged H15 candidate; no inference about real GLM frequency, quality or token calibration.
statement: One generic archive recovery can satisfy the completion gate while a previously delivered revised fact is absent from final context and no recovery tool remains offered.
